feeds.title: My Cranio Sacral Life Blog
feeds.description: Biodynamic Cranio Sacral Therapy with Sophie restores wholeness through deep listening and neutral holding of Health's Intelligence speaking in rhythmic motion in our tissues, fluid and potency. MY CRANIO SACRAL LIFE is her life history where she talks about her life as a biodynamic craniosacral therapist.

feeds.title: Ready 2 Heal Blog
feeds.description: At Ready2Heal, Kerstin S. Tracy provides Craniosacral Therapy & Feng Shui to humans and horses. Learn more about health-related issues in CranioSacral therapy, Feng Shui and Equine CranioSacral Bodywork that can benefit you and your horse through personal blogs from Ready2Heal.

feeds.title: The Craniosacral Therapy Association
feeds.description: Craniosacral Therapy Association (CSTA), is committed to increasing understanding of CST among the public, media, government and health professionals. Encouraging the use of complementary and natural therapies alongside conventional medical approaches. A list of topics related to Craniosacral Therapy is available to read from in our blog.

feeds.title: Beatrice Doubble Craniosacral Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Beatrice Doubble Health & Wellbeing offers treatments that harness the body's ability to transform into its natural state, wholeness and clarity. It can be used in conjunction with conventional medical treatment. Learn through our blog, where we educate about Craniosacral Therapy and its wonders.

feeds.title: Craniosacral Therapist Maria Gies Blog
feeds.description: Maria Gies Craniosacral, as a registered nurse and therapist, has a good understanding of health care needs. Touch therapy with profound positive physical and emotional health benefits balances your central nervous system, Improves immune response to disease. My blog goes into detail on what is Craniosacral Therapy, Why use craniosacral therapy, and How it works.

feeds.title: Craniosacral Therapy and Massage Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Craniosacral Therapy and Massage Therapy is dedicated to holistic wellness. We offer Craniosacral Therapy, Massage Therapy, Craniosacral Therapy (CST) for Pediatrics & Tandem Craniosacral Therapy. Our Blogs let you get to know our therapists, in their own words.

feeds.title: CranioSacral Center of Grand Rapids Blog
feeds.description: Craniosacral Center of Grand Rapids provides craniosacral therapy with expertise babies and young children. We treat chronic pain, migraines, tongue tie, breastfeeding problems, ADHD, autism and more. Learn how craniosacral therapy can help you and your family release tension and address a range of issues in our blog.

feeds.title: Barbara Gornall Blog
feeds.description: Barbara is a qualified Craniosacral Therapist and is qualified as a Midwife and has specialised in neonatal intensive care, working with families and as an infant feeding supporter. The blog has detailed articles on tips, benefits, added info, recipes and How Craniosacral Therapy works with the nervous system.

feeds.title: Kate Mackinnon's Blog
feeds.description: Collaborative Navigation of Your Health and Wellness offers CranioSacral Therapy through virtual sessions, coaching for practitioners, and holdings for Embodied Intention Groups. Learn more about CranioSacral Therapy and Compassionate Touch from leading authority Kate Mackinnon.
